name: thales_imperva_reputation
author: Luca Memini
description: Query Imperva Reputation Intelligence for an IPv4 address. Returns risk score, geolocation, ASN, known usage (e.g. tor), known attacks, violations, client applications and targeted industries.

configurationItems.name: api_id
configurationItems.description: Imperva API ID (sent as x-API-Id header)

configurationItems.name: api_key
configurationItems.description: Imperva API Key (sent as x-API-Key header)

configurationItems.name: base_url
configurationItems.description: Imperva Reputation Intelligence API base URL
